title: Piercing Frame Trio #015 (가슴 컷 · [일반·P25 집중형·공예(Polish Bolesławiec pottery)·메이크업 아마갸루] ; [일반·P50 정의형·이레즈미·메이크업 텔레노벨라글램] ; [맥시·P50 정의형·스테인드글라스·체형 wide hip narrow])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, bust shot. THREE women standing side by side, each facing the camera straight on, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed from the very top of their heads to just below their chests, the frame cutting off beneath the chests. Every face sits large and sharp in the upper half of the frame, and every woman's ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge antique-brass segment ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide antique-brass ear cuff, three smaller antique-brass rings, two thick antique-brass bars and a small antique-brass stud up to the top; one small antique-brass stud sits in the right ear; four antique-brass pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small antique-brass rings pass through the left nostril and a thick antique-brass septum ring hangs below the nose; a antique-brass hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a antique-brass snake-bite ring beside it and a small antique-brass ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a antique-brass Medusa stud sits above the lips; a antique-brass labret stud and a small antique-brass ring sit on the chin; three small antique-brass studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small sapphires set into the metal.
#1 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Latina woman — warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, bright golden-blonde hair styled in twin-tail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick mixed-metal septum ring with a smaller mixed-metal ring above it and two mixed-metal rings through each nostril; a straight mixed-metal bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three mixed-metal pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a mixed-metal Medusa stud above the lips; a big mixed-metal hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a mixed-metal labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small mixed-metal studs along each jaw; a curved row of small mixed-metal studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized mixed-metal hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine mixed-metal chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#2 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with one material instead of ordinary skin: traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, bamboo forest formations in DEEP EMERALD and JADE, extreme high-gloss oil finish, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

#3: A striking adult woman — THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, soft pastel-lavender hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a bold, commanding expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#3 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick rose-gold septum ring with a smaller rose-gold ring above it and two rose-gold rings through each nostril; a straight rose-gold bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three rose-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a rose-gold Medusa stud above the lips; a big rose-gold hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a rose-gold labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small rose-gold studs along each jaw; a curved row of small rose-gold studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized rose-gold hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine rose-gold chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#3 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with one material instead of ordinary skin: solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
